title: Oracle
text:
Oracle is an Ascendancy class for the Druid.


== Overview ==
The Oracle uses the power of Foresight to outmatch his foes and unlock new abilities. With Fateful Vision, the Oracle can see his future self using a random skill, which gets empowered if he does the same. With Converging Paths, he can bring a future vision of an enemy about to become immobilised into the present to harm it while it's vulnerable. The Oracle can manipulate the odds in his favor with The Lesser Harm to make enemy damage and critical hit chance unlucky, and Forced Outcome to always guarantee his hits become critical hits, at the cost of potential damage. The Unseen Path allows the Oracle to take passives on the passive skill tree no other classes have access to, and Entwined Realities to allocate unconnected passives near keystones. Additionally, Unnamed Heartwood grants additional totem limit and delays their death, and Harmony Within grants an alternative way to use mana as a life pool.
